title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.44: Removed the temporary Fate Knocking damage logging added in v1.12.41 - the preview issues it was tracking are fixed, and the remaining case turned out to be correct behaviour (Sharp and Strength scale the finisher just as they scale each strike). No gameplay changes.
